# Outline

Status: Act I is draft 1 for the author's direction. Chapter numbers will shift;
beats are what matter.

## The acts

| Act | Years | What it accomplishes |
|---|---|---|
| I | 1929 to 1934 | The ice trade contracts. Odile takes the books, Wilfred takes the risk. |
| II | 1935 to 1942 | The cannery converts. The pond house closes. |

## Act I

| # | Story date | Title (working) | Beat | POV | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | January 1929 | The Last Full Cut | The crew cuts a full pond in a hard January while the cannery's order is already halved. Odile keeps the tally in the scale house and does not tell her brother what the column adds to. Ends on the loaded sled going up the ramp. | Odile | draft |
| 2 | Winter 1931 | Black Ice | A thin January. Wilfred puts the crew out on ice that rings wrong under the horse. Odile refuses to weigh what comes off it. The argument in the scale house is about the ledger and is not about the ledger. | Odile | outline |
| 3 | Summer 1931 | The Route | The domestic route down to nine stops. Odile drives it herself and learns what the town says about the pond house. | Odile | outline |
| 4 | 1934 | The Hoist | The rope parts. Marcel's hand. The doctor comes up from the county seat over a road that is mud. | Wilfred | outline |

### Open questions for Act I

- Whether the schooner is named in Act I or held back until the storm.
